slope-field-grid.alt: Short segments at the 25 integer points with x and y from −2 to 2. Each segment has slope x + y: slope 0 along the line y = −x, steep positive slopes up to 4 at (2, 2), and steep negative slopes down to −4 at (−2, −2). The nine points with x and y from −1 to 1 are labelled with their slopes.
